Name: JP's Farms - Four Seasons Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u][center]Four Seasons Farm[/center][/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=5]Why wait for that time of year to grow when you can just go to the next farm![/size][/color][/i][/b]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A farm divided into 4 connected maps, each with a season.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Each section corresponds to a season where you can only sow seeds of that season.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The Spring and Fall farms produce harvestables every day, the Summer farm has a quarry. The winter farm has special grass for animals, and animals will be able to go out even in bad weather on this map.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i][color=#ff7700]Original size of the Standard Farm (80x65) >>> Each of these maps (80x80) + Cliffs removed for more space in general.[/color][/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list]
[youtube]hN10ZL3g-lk[/youtube]

[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]This is a fairly general summary of what you will find but I hope you like it![/i][/size][/color]


[color=#ff00ff][size=6][b][i][u]Translations:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4][/color]If you want, you can make the translation of this mod, [color=#ff0000]no need to ask for permission[/color], and you can publish it on your own in Nexus. [color=#ffff00]This is best because I won't be available to update the translations if you send it to me.[/color] [color=#f4f4f4][/color][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]I will not do the usual translations into Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese either, so you are more than welcome to do translations into these languages. [/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][b][size=4]If you like you can let me know when you have published your translations so that I know you are there.[/size][size=3] [/size][/b][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][b][color=#00ff00][size=5]Thank you![/size][/color][/b][/font]
[/list]

Unzip and move the folder directly to the Mods folder. If you like the mod, click the “Endorse” button at the top of the page ;)
